title: GIF workspace: the preview spinner never stops, the strip does not follow a handle drag, and Home/End/I/O are unbound
description: Three faults from Fabio's pass over the new GIF output tool (2026-09-20). The preview pane's spinner spins forever (it is hidden on the wrong element). Dragging the trim handles does not repaint the frame strip until pointerup, because MpiTrimBar only emits range-change on commit. The GIF control bar binds three of the video hotkey ids and not Home/End/I/O.
